purpose: Challenge the exact Campaign045 volatility/activity lead-lag asymmetry against every nearby terminal family before implementation or protected-value access.

candidate.name: intraday_volatility_activity_lead_lag_asymmetry_236p
candidate.formula: Within each 120-close half, form 119 adjacent log returns r_j and destination-bar activity a_j=log1p(amount_{j+1}). Across the 118 adjacent return/activity pairs per half, pooled to 236, return Corr(abs(r_j),a_{j+1}) - Corr(a_j,abs(r_{j+1})) using equal-position population Pearson correlations.

mechanism_family_review.reason: Those mechanisms are contemporaneous. Campaign045 compares the two opposite one-step causal alignments and cancels common synchronous association through their exact difference.

Campaign045 uses absolute return magnitudes and contrasts activity-leading-volatility with volatility-leading-activity. It contains no signed-return forecast, positive/negative split, return-per-CNY ratio, or up-move amount share.

Campaign045 reads no transaction VWAP, share volume, or transaction-price change and does not correlate adjacent return magnitudes with themselves. Its clock direction is identified by exchanging activity and volatility roles.

Return time-reversal uses an antisymmetric cubic contrast of adjacent signed returns, while market response delay exchanges stock and leave-one-out market returns. Campaign045 exchanges own-stock absolute volatility and own-stock CNY activity and uses two Pearson correlations.

Campaign045 does not score the marginal amount distribution, serial persistence, or clock-time center. Amount is paired only with neighboring return magnitude and enters both directions symmetrically.

Campaign044 is an all-terminal percentile combination. Campaign045 reads no terminal value and is one raw close-and-amount mechanism; the complete composite is still included as the final statistical comparison.

Candidate49 counts own close sign crossings around a causal cumulative VWAP and remains future-only. Campaign045 uses no volume, cumulative VWAP, crossing, Candidate49 value, return, signal, or execution state. Candidate49 is a no-return uniqueness comparison only.

One exact raw factor, one direction, one lag, one amount transform, and one fixed full-session support are frozen. No alternative transform, threshold, subwindow, board, year, cost, regime, fit, or combination is opened.

design_choices_frozen_before_values.reactive_component: population PearsonCorr(abs(r_j),a_{j+1}) over 236 pooled within-half pairs
design_choices_frozen_before_values.anticipatory_component: population PearsonCorr(a_j,abs(r_{j+1})) over the same 236 pooled pairs
design_choices_frozen_before_values.variance_semantics: strictly positive population variance for both component denominators
